title: Jammy Fluffy Greek Pak Choi Plaki Gigantes
description: A twist on traditional Greek gigantes plaki, featuring tender baby pak choy, a flavorful mortar-pounded sauce, and a sweet, jammy finish.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and translucent, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the red wine vinegar, honey, water, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and reduced slightly.
Add the baby pak choi to the saucepan and toss to coat with the sauce.
Continue cooking, covered, for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the pak choi is tender but still crisp.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the jammy pak choi hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
